# Missing Configuration Error Handling

The read_config function raises a CompileError if the required configuration file (kc.toml) is not found. This risk pertains to a dependency on configuration being present and correctly set up before compilation can proceed.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
